description:
I am the Tech Lead for cloud development in the raw materials sector, working alongside a team of 50 developers.
This position is highly versatile, allowing me to acquire new skills daily in areas such as networking, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, architecture, and development.
At the core of my role is the understanding of business requirements and delivering customer-focused solutions. I also facilitate code reviews, share knowledge, and promote best practices among development teams, maintaining a mindset of continuous improvement regarding stability, resilience, and performance.
I have a strong belief in the importance of conventions, and my aim is to establish standards that reduce risks and friction points between services. To this end, I have successfully published packages (NuGet, NPM & Helm), including a design system in React, cross-cutting NuGets to encapsulate essential features (tested and versioned) like application RBAC, and K8s Helm charts. Additionally, I have created templates to implement these essential features and demonstrate usage and best practices.
